notes: 设置-通用-配置同步摘要行：展开时先请求 check 触发 git fetch 更新 @{upstream} 再刷新，远端「落后/领先/未提交」显示云端最新值而非旧值，展开期间每 30 秒自动刷新、收起即停；四个「生成脚本」按钮换成「立即拉取（会关闭 DSH）」与「立即推送（会关闭 DSH）」两个，走主面板自动同步同一条 pull-now / push-now 队列，按后端门禁置灰并给中文提示。
notesEn: Settings → General → Config Sync summary row: expanding now requests check to trigger a git fetch (refresh @{upstream}) before refreshing, so remote behind/ahead/uncommitted figures show the latest cloud values instead of stale ones, auto-refreshing every 30s while expanded; the four generate-script buttons are replaced by Pull now (closes DSH) and Push now (closes DSH), sharing the main panel automation queue with backend-gated buttons and Chinese feedback.
